    <h1>Fiscal policy, public debt and policy evaluation</h1>
    <p>I study what fiscal consolidations do to public debt in the European Union,
    how households make financial decisions, and what event-study estimates
    measure when governments act in response to the outcomes they want to
    change.</p>
    <p>My work has appeared in the <em>Journal of Behavioral and Experimental
